breaking_news.headline: Here is how SpaceX could turn up in your current investments

breaking_news.headline: Alan Greenspan, the legendary former Federal Reserve chair, dies

breaking_news.headline: Did you know? Alan Greenspan and Ayn Rand were close friends
breaking_news.summary: One of the most intellectually important relationships in the life of the late Fed chair Alan Greenspan was with his close friend, the formidable novelist and libertarian thinker Ayn Rand.

breaking_news.headline: When falling housing prices are good news — and when they're not

breaking_news.headline: Is AI 'one big bubble'? Behind the tech sell-off
breaking_news.summary: Investors are selling off AI-related stocks as doubts are starting to surface over whether the massive spending on AI is worth the investment and whether it's "one big bubble."

breaking_news.headline: Congress passes the largest housing affordability bill in decades — and Trump cancels the signing
breaking_news.summary: President Trump canceled a signing ceremony for the bill Wednesday, saying Congress must first pass a strict voter ID bill.

breaking_news.headline: Meta plans to release AI-powered prediction market app, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The company is building an app separate from Facebook and Instagram where people can wager on the outcome of real-world events, using "play money."

breaking_news.headline: Colombia's left-wing presidential candidate concedes defeat
breaking_news.summary: Senator Iván Cepeda was beaten by right-wing businessman Abelardo de la Espriella by less than a percentage point.

breaking_news.headline: French woman allegedly held captive by husband for 12 years rescued in Pakistan
breaking_news.summary: Yasmina alleges she was held along with her five children, and they were all cut off from the outside world.

breaking_news.headline: France confirms first Ebola case
breaking_news.summary: The French doctor had been working in DR Congo, where more than 260 people are known to have died.

breaking_news.headline: Biggest city in Crimea without power after Ukraine strikes
breaking_news.summary: Sevastopol's Moscow-installed governor warns there will be no electricity in some areas until the evening.

breaking_news.headline: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
breaking_news.summary: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.

breaking_news.headline: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
breaking_news.summary: Rafael Grossi says the IAEA is "working on modalities" but an Iranian  minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

breaking_news.headline: Air conditioning creates political divide after France records hottest day

breaking_news.headline: Power outages hit France as it records hottest day since measurements began
breaking_news.summary: France has recorded it hottest day since records began in 1947, its national weather agency says, breaking a record set on Tuesday.

breaking_news.headline: Why are there holiday delay warnings over the EU's new border system?
